difficultyScale: 1 = gentlest (what is a function). 5 = deep (trace an event through the sim). Ramp only per the rules in daily-prompt.md.

curriculum.title: What a function is
curriculum.hint: Use simulate() in packages/core as the concrete example: inputs -> output.

curriculum.title: The two phases: shop (recruit) vs combat
curriculum.hint: docs/GAME-RULES.md + CLAUDE.md: build a board, then it auto-resolves.

curriculum.title: What an auto-battler is / the core loop
curriculum.hint: 17-round course, boards fight on their own.

curriculum.title: What 'deterministic' means
curriculum.hint: Same inputs -> same outputs, every time. Why replays work.

curriculum.title: Pure functions (no side effects)
curriculum.hint: simulate() computes an event log; the UI never computes outcomes.

curriculum.title: Data-driven cards: data vs code
curriculum.hint: Cards are data + effect subscriptions, not bespoke classes.

curriculum.title: The monorepo: core / content / sim / ui
curriculum.hint: CLAUDE.md Monorepo section. What each package is responsible for.

curriculum.title: The event log and replay
curriculum.hint: simulate returns { events, result, ... }; UI animates the log on its own clock.

curriculum.title: Cards live in SETS
curriculum.hint: packages/content/src/sets.ts; a run pins its set.

curriculum.title: Effects as data subscriptions
curriculum.hint: Battlecry/Deathrattle etc. as effect factories, not classes.

curriculum.title: Testing: vitest, determinism + golden tests
curriculum.hint: npm test; golden/determinism tests lock behavior.

curriculum.title: Lint rules that protect the design
curriculum.hint: The Math.random ban is ESLint-enforced in core/content/sim.

notes: Seeded 2026-08-14. First quiz run 2026-08-14 (quiz #1): the curriculum only has 3 difficulty-1 topics (not 4 as the prompt's first-run rule assumes), so quiz #1 used all 3 plus the first 2 difficulty-2 topics in curriculum order to reach 5 questions.
